checked.zh-CN: 选中状态。不为 `undefined` 时为受控：显示由该值决定，点击只触发 onChange，需在回调中更新该值。变回 `undefined` 后取消选中并转为非受控。
checked.en-US: Checked state. When not `undefined` it is controlled: the value decides what is shown, and a click only calls onChange, so update the value in the callback. Setting it back to `undefined` unchecks the switch and makes it uncontrolled.

checkedText.zh-CN: 选中时展示的内容，size 为 `small` 时不显示。
checkedText.en-US: Content shown when checked. Not shown when size is `small`.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

defaultChecked.zh-CN: 非受控时的初始选中状态，只在首次渲染时读取。
defaultChecked.en-US: Initial checked state when uncontrolled. Read only once, on the first render.

loading.zh-CN: 是否处于加载中；加载中 input 仍可聚焦并带 `aria-disabled`，切换被忽略且不触发 onChange。
loading.en-US: Whether the switch is loading. While loading, the input stays focusable with `aria-disabled`; toggles are ignored and onChange is not called.

name.zh-CN: 原生 input 的 name，用于表单提交。
name.en-US: Name of the native input, used when the form is submitted.

onChange.zh-CN: 切换状态时的回调，参数为新的选中状态与原生 change 事件；加载中不触发。
onChange.en-US: Called when the user toggles the switch, with the new checked state and the native change event. Not called while loading.

onMouseEnter.zh-CN: 鼠标移入根元素时的回调。
onMouseEnter.en-US: Called when the pointer enters the root element.

onMouseLeave.zh-CN: 鼠标移出根元素时的回调。
onMouseLeave.en-US: Called when the pointer leaves the root element.

uncheckedText.zh-CN: 未选中时展示的内容，size 为 `small` 时不显示。
uncheckedText.en-US: Content shown when unchecked. Not shown when size is `small`.
